# penlike

> Model how an author, a group or a corpus writes, register by register, and give agents the skills to write in that style


## Pages in this subsection

- [penlike](penlike.html.md): Model how an author, a group or a corpus writes, and write in that style.
- [penlike.base](penlike.base.html.md): The shared vocabulary: the document record, text cleaning, dates and the error type.
- [penlike.data](penlike.data.html.md): The skills and agents shipped with penlike, as package data.
- [penlike.features](penlike.features.html.md): Measure how a text is written: the cheap tier, standard library only.
- [penlike.mcp](penlike.mcp.html.md): MCP over stdio: the same verbs, for local MCP clients.
- [penlike.profile](penlike.profile.html.md): Profiles: what a set of texts has in common, and how far a draft is from it.
- [penlike.routing](penlike.routing.html.md): Registers: filing texts by situation, finding new ones, and routing a request to one.
- [penlike.screening](penlike.screening.html.md): Screening: keeping machine-written text out of a model of a person. Optional.
- [penlike.sourcers](penlike.sourcers.html.md): Sourcers: where the writing comes from. Read-only, by construction.
- [penlike.store](penlike.store.html.md): Where models live, and the one object that reads and writes them.
- [penlike.tools](penlike.tools.html.md): The verbs: every operation penlike offers, as plain functions returning JSON-ready dicts.

## Optional

- [Top-level llms.txt](../llms.txt): Complete documentation index.
